volvo-ex30.file: File:Volvo EX30 Extended Range Cloud Blue - front.jpg
volvo-ex30.author: Ethan Llamas
volvo-ex30.alt: Volvo EX30 in Cloud Blue, front three-quarter view
volvo-ex30.note: Current (only) EX30 generation: pixel 'Thor's hammer' lamps, closed front panel, EX30 badge. Export car (Philippines), visually identical to the India-assembled EX30; Cloud Blue is an Indian colour.

volvo-ex30.author: Vauxford
volvo-ex30.alt: Volvo EX30 in Crystal White with black roof, rear three-quarter view
volvo-ex30.note: EX30 rear with vertical tail-lamp stack and VOLVO lettering; same design as sold in India. Crystal White is an Indian colour.

volvo-ex30.file: File:Volvo EX30 Ultra Single Motor Extended Range (ZAA-2E400R) interior.jpg
volvo-ex30.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
volvo-ex30.alt: Volvo EX30 Ultra Single Motor Extended Range dashboard with central portrait touchscreen
volvo-ex30.note: Japanese-market EX30 Ultra single-motor (ZAA-2E400R), right-hand drive like the Indian car; same dashboard and portrait screen.

volvo-ec40.author: Alexander Migl
volvo-ec40.alt: Volvo EC40 in Vapour Grey, front three-quarter view
volvo-ec40.note: Wears the EC40 badge (the renamed C40 Recharge); coupe-roof body, pixel headlamps. Export car (Germany), visually identical to the EC40 sold in India; Vapour Grey is an Indian colour.

volvo-ec40.file: File:Volvo EC40 Crystal White Pearl - rear.jpg
volvo-ec40.author: Ethan Llamas
volvo-ec40.alt: Volvo EC40 in Crystal White, rear three-quarter view
volvo-ec40.note: EC40-badged car (Philippines) showing the sloping coupe roofline and split tail lamps; same design as in India.

volvo-ec40.file: File:Volvo C40 RECHARGE Ultimate Twin Motor (ZAA-XE400AXCE) interior.jpg
volvo-ec40.author: Tokumeigakarinoaoshima
volvo-ec40.alt: Volvo C40/EC40 Twin Motor dashboard with portrait touchscreen
volvo-ec40.note: Japanese C40 Recharge Ultimate Twin Motor, right-hand drive like India. The EC40 is the renamed C40 with the same cabin; the photo predates the rename.

volvo-xc60.author: Alexander Migl
volvo-xc60.alt: Volvo XC60 (2025 facelift) in Crystal White, front three-quarter view
volvo-xc60.note: 2025 facelift (model year 2026): new grille with diagonal pattern and redesigned bumper intakes. German car with dark exterior trim and black wheels; the Indian B5 Ultra may have different trim and wheels. Crystal White is an Indian colour.

volvo-xc60.author: Alexander Migl
volvo-xc60.alt: Volvo XC60 (2025 facelift) in Crystal White, rear three-quarter view
volvo-xc60.note: Same German 2025-facelift car as the front photo, with black wheels and dark trim.

volvo-xc60.file: File:2026 Volvo XC60 (SPA) autoMOBIL Tübingen 2025 DSC 2780.jpg
volvo-xc60.author: Alexander Migl
volvo-xc60.alt: Volvo XC60 (2025 facelift) dashboard with 11.2-inch portrait touchscreen and light upholstery
volvo-xc60.note: Facelift cabin with the larger 11.2-inch centre screen. Left-hand-drive German car; India is right-hand drive.

volvo-xc90.file: File:Volvo XC90 II FL2 T8 AWD Recharge PHEV Crystal White Pearl 01.jpg
volvo-xc90.author: Ethan Llamas
volvo-xc90.alt: Volvo XC90 (2025 facelift) in Crystal White, front three-quarter view
volvo-xc90.note: Second facelift (2025): diagonal-slat grille, slimmer headlamps, new bumper. Export T8 plug-in hybrid (Philippines); body identical to the Indian B5. Crystal White is an Indian colour.

volvo-xc90.file: File:Volvo XC90 II FL2 T8 AWD Recharge PHEV Crystal White Pearl 02.jpg
volvo-xc90.author: Ethan Llamas
volvo-xc90.alt: Volvo XC90 (2025 facelift) in Crystal White, rear three-quarter view
volvo-xc90.note: 2025 facelift; same car as the front photo.

volvo-xc90.file: File:2025 Volvo XC90 B5 Dark AWD front.jpg
volvo-xc90.author: LuvsMG481
volvo-xc90.alt: Volvo XC90 B5 (2025 facelift) in Crystal White, side view from the front
volvo-xc90.note: Right-hand-drive Australian XC90 B5 AWD mild hybrid, the same powertrain as India. It has Dark exterior trim (black grille surround).

volvo-xc90.file: File:2025 Volvo XC90 II Auto Zuerich 2024 DSC 6714.jpg
volvo-xc90.author: Alexander-93
volvo-xc90.alt: Volvo XC90 (2025 facelift) dashboard with 11.2-inch touchscreen
volvo-xc90.note: Facelift cabin with the larger 11.2-inch screen. Left-hand drive; India is right-hand drive.

volvo-ex90.file: File:Volvo EX90 Twin Motor Performance Ultra SPA2 Crystal White (5).jpg
volvo-ex90.author: Damian B Oh
volvo-ex90.alt: Volvo EX90 in Crystal White, front three-quarter view
volvo-ex90.note: Model-year 2026 EX90 (SPA2, 800 V) in a dealer showroom. Export car, visually identical to the Indian EX90; Crystal White is an Indian colour.

volvo-ex90.file: File:Volvo EX90 Twin Motor Plus – h 14022026.jpg
volvo-ex90.author: © M 93
volvo-ex90.alt: Volvo EX90 Twin Motor in Vapour Grey, rear three-quarter view
volvo-ex90.note: German EX90 Twin Motor in Vapour Grey, an Indian colour. Shows the EX90 C-shaped tail lamps.

volvo-ex90.author: Alexander-93
volvo-ex90.alt: Volvo EX90 dashboard with portrait centre screen and driver display
volvo-ex90.note: EX90 cabin. Left-hand drive; India is right-hand drive.
